snippets.snippet_text: "I use Payhip mostly because I heard they handle additional EU VAT prices, despite them having 5% take off of prices [...] But I noticed that very few people actually interact with any Payhip stores, at all, meanwhile people with Patreon and Ko-fi get all the visitors. I know people avoid using Payhip to sell items due to poor customer service and all, but I haven't heard anything from the buyer's side? I see more seller than buyer review posts. And very little buyer interaction."
